intuition: Greedily pack the longest prefix of words that fits, then distribute each line's spaces according to whether it is final.

brute_force.approach: Try every possible line break and enumerate all whitespace distributions for each line.

optimal.approach: Choose maximal word groups, use quotient/remainder to spread spaces evenly, and left-align the final line.

edge_cases: A line with one word receives trailing spaces.
The final line is left-justified with single spaces between words.
Extra spaces on a nonfinal line go to its leftmost gaps.
